proposals.before: In the winter of the second year of Tianqing (1023), members of the Music Office were all required to wear robes.
proposals.after: In the winter of the second year of Tianqing (1112), members of the Music Office were all required to wear robes.
proposals.reason: Liao Tianqing year 2 is AD 1112 (Emperor Tianzuo), not 1023; the parenthetical Western year is wrong.

proposals.before: During the Tonghe era (983–1011), the practice was discontinued.
proposals.after: During the Tonghe era (983–1012), the practice was discontinued.
proposals.reason: Packet reign mapping and standard Liao chronology give Tonghe as AD 983–1012 (thirty years), not through 1011.

proposals.before: When each has finished awaiting orders, those of low stool rank and above are led forward and asked, 'May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.'
proposals.after: When each has finished awaiting orders, those of low stool rank and above are led forward and inquire, 'May Your Sacred Person enjoy ten thousand blessings.'
proposals.reason: Chinese 問 is spoken by the officials who inquire after the emperor; the literal reverses the agent to 'asked'.

proposals.before: The arrow-verifying officer advances again, takes his place, bows, and announces in full title that the subject reports the imperial arrow verification agrees, then withdraws to stand in the center of the gate.
proposals.after: The arrow-verifying officer advances again, takes his place, bows, and announces in full title that the subject so-and-so reports the imperial arrow verification agrees, then withdraws to stand in the center of the gate.
proposals.reason: Chinese 臣某 is the ritual placeholder 'subject so-and-so'; the idiomatic English drops 某.

proposals.before: The Privy Council gate conveys the announcement, "The king inquires whether you are well." The envoys all kneel, and the lead envoy replies, "When we departed, we inquired after his well-being."
proposals.after: The Privy Council gate conveys the announcement, "Is Wang Xun well?" The envoys all kneel, and the lead envoy replies, "When we departed, Xun was well."
proposals.reason: In the Liao envoy formula, 王詢 is the Goryeo king's personal name (paralleled by 某安否 for Western Xia); 詢 is not the verb 'inquire'.

proposals.before: The Privy Council gate conveys the announcement, "The king inquires whether you are well"; the envoys all kneel; the lead envoy reports, "When we departed, we inquired after his well-being."
proposals.after: The Privy Council gate conveys the announcement, "Is Wang Xun well?"; the envoys all kneel; the lead envoy reports, "When we departed, Xun was well."
proposals.reason: Parallel to the Xia formula 某安否 / 某安: 王詢 and bare 詢 are the king's name, not the verb 'inquire'.

proposals.before: After the Crane Control officers complete obeisance, the usher bows and announces that the King of Goryeo presents tribute with his greetings.
proposals.after: After the Crane Control officers complete obeisance, the usher bows and announces that Wang Xun, King of Goryeo, presents tribute.
proposals.reason: 高麗國王詢 names King Wang Xun; 詢 is not an 'inquiry/greetings' verb in this announcement formula.

proposals.before: When officers of the Crane Control guard complete obeisance, the usher bows and announces the King of Goryeo's inquiry and tribute presentation.
proposals.after: When officers of the Crane Control guard complete obeisance, the usher bows and announces that Wang Xun, King of Goryeo, presents tribute.
proposals.reason: 高麗國王詢 is the king's name plus title before 進奉; rendering 詢 as 'inquiry' is a mistranslation.

decisions.reason: s0057 dates the Music Office robe rule to 天慶二年冬. Liao Tianqing began in AD 1111 under Tianzuo, so year 2 is AD 1112; the parenthetical 1023 is factually wrong, and 1112 is the correct Western year.
s0026 places the discontinuation 統和中. Tonghe ran thirty years from AD 983 into 1012 (when Kaitai began), so the era span should be 983–1012, not through 1011.
In 可矮墩以上引近前，問「聖躬萬福」, the officials led forward are the agents of 問, greeting the emperor. Passive 'asked' reverses agent and patient; active 'inquire' matches the Chinese and the idiomatic field.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 可矮墩以上引近前，問「聖躬萬福」

decisions.reason: s0094 has 自通全銜臣某對禦勘箭同; 臣某 is the ritual placeholder 'subject so-and-so'. The before idiomatic drops 某; restoring 'so-and-so' matches the Chinese and the unit's literal.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 自通全銜臣某對禦勘箭同

decisions.reason: 閣門傳宣「王詢安否」…大使奏「臣等來時詢安」 uses 王詢 / 詢 as the Goryeo king's personal name in the health-inquiry formula, not the verb 'inquire'. The proposed idiomatic correctly asks whether Wang Xun is well and reports that Xun was well.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 王詢安否…臣等來時詢安

decisions.reason: The literal repeats the same misreading of 王詢 and bare 詢 as 'inquire'. Rendering them as the king's name in both the announcement and the reply restores the Chinese sense.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 王詢安否…臣等來時詢安

decisions.reason: 通高麗國王詢進奉 announces tribute in the name of King of Goryeo, Xun (Wang Xun). Treating 詢 as 'greetings/inquiry' invents a verb; naming Wang Xun as the tribute presenter is accurate.
The literal likewise misreads 詢 in 高麗國王詢進奉 as 'inquiry'. The proposed wording correctly treats 詢 as the king's given name before 進奉.
